english.title: Consign animal for intra-community trade w/o approved tag in each ear in accordance with Art 4(1) of (EC) reg 1760/2000
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) consigned an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..) for intra-Community trade when it was not tagged in each ear with an ear tag approved by the Secretary of State in accordance with Article 4(1) of Regulation (EC) No 1760/2000
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4 and 15 of, and paragraph 8 of Schedule 1 to, the Cattle Identification Regulations 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
